title: Preparation of Flame Retardant Cotton Fabric Using Environmental Friendly Supercritical Carbon Dioxide
journal: International Journal of Materials Science and Applications
treatment_method: Immerse cotton in 50% aqueous isopropanol containing flame retardant and pad at 10 psi. Treat in supercritical CO2 at 90 C for 2 h under 1800-2000 psi. Dry at 100 C for 5 min and cure at 160 C for 4 min.
LOI_method: Dynisco oxygen index chamber; ASTM D2863 edition conflicts: abstract/introduction -09 versus section 2.5.3 -13.
TG_locator: Table 2, p 274: fabric rows keyed by agent and add-on; char yield at 600 C.
LOI_locator: Section 3.4, p 274: six exact LOI values in explicit add-on order.
conditions_locator: Sections 2.5.2-2.5.3, pp 270-271: nitrogen, 10 C/min, room temperature to 600 C; LOI method and conditioning.
pairing_evidence: The exact pdp/pdpt fabric add-on labels in Table 2 match the ordered LOI/add-on series in section 3.4. Neat additives are separate rows and are not paired. No durability-washed specimens are assigned these initial TG values.
limitations: Exact nitrogen R600 is used. Table 2 multi-stage onsets are retained source-native and are not relabeled as DTG maxima. ASTM edition conflict is preserved, with no inferred correction. Untreated control has only a generic LOI range and inconsistent residue prose, so it is excluded. Air mentioned in introduction has no separate reported numerical TG condition.
